name: The Knights' Endroll
source:
It's the day of the memorial service for the fallen knights.

Clarissa Edelrose is looking at the names of her fallen comrades that are carved on the memorial monument.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/the-knights-endroll]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这一天是为阵亡骑士举行追悼会的日子。

克拉丽莎·埃德尔罗斯正在看着纪念碑上刻着的阵亡战友的名字。

[来自[url=https://altila.itch.io/the-knights-endroll]itch.io[/url]]
